MARKS AT THE NON-GENERIC CENTRE. geoMarkPosition (l.75-77) puts vertex i at (i,0) and visit v at geometricVisitPosition hP v = (v.2.val, crossingParameter v.1 v.2.val _) (GeometricVisits.lean:12-16; Crossings.lean:70-78: the actual parameter with crossingPoint = edgePoint P i t). geoMarkList (l.136) sorts Finset.univ by geoMarkKey = traversalKey ∘ geoMarkPosition, traversalKey (i,t) = i.val + t (Traversal.lean:17) — exactly def:gauss's order (i,t)<(i,t')<(i+1,·), cut at vertex 0 (key 0; all other marks have key > 0). The crossing set is Crossing g.center = remote edge pairs whose closed segments meet (Crossings.lean:12-15); flatCentreCG (l.492) = flat_crossingGeometry supplies interior+transverse (CrossingGeometry.lean:11-15), so closed-vs-relint is immaterial and this is lem:flat-sides (ii)'s 'central crossing data read from the segments of P(0) exactly as for a generic polygon … no function on the generic locus is evaluated'. Position data depend on hP only through Prop proofs, so the construction is intrinsic. Edge cases checked: the pairs {j-1,j+1} and {j-2,j} are not crossings at the centre (μ_{j+1} ∉ E_{j-1} because μ_j is strictly between), so no visit sits at the collinear triple; no crossing point is a vertex (FlatSidesData / CrossingGeometry), so geoMarkPosition_injective holds without genericity.

2. SUCCESSOR AND RECONNECTION. geoMarkSuccessor = Cycle.next on the sorted list (l.166-190), cyclic, so the last mark's successor is vertex 0. geoSmoothingSuccessor hP S = (selectedMarkPerm S).trans ρ, i.e. ρ_S(a) = ρ(σ a) (l.233-238) with σ = sumCongr refl (selectedVisitTwinPerm S), selectedVisitTwin S v = if v.1 ∈ S then visitTwin v else v (CarrierVisitTwin.lean:80-81; CarrierSmoothing.lean:36-38). Between two consecutive corners a carrier follows one original edge through unselected visits, so each corner-polygon edge is a positive multiple of that edge (block compression) and the turn at a vertex corner is τ_i, at a smoothing corner sgn det(d_e,d_f) — lem:carriers (ii). geoCornerTurn (l.444) is certified by geoCornerMark_geoCornerIndex (l.433), unique since the corner list is nodup.
